objective: V3.9.9 — Memory Judgment + Work Intelligence: Crowley knows what is fresh, useful, and what work is next — before V4 connectivity.
context: V3.9.8 Runtime Hardening shipped (#50–#55): test mode, model probe, runtime health, sqlite-vec fallback, fragile-startup suite. V3.9.9 is the next quality gate — brain upgrades on top of a boringly reliable floor.
decisions: Two tracks in one release: Memory Judgment (Track A) + Work Intelligence (Track B)
One ticket at a time with QA gate — same process as V3.9.8
Do not mint/build until Mr. Go approves this packet
V4 connectivity starts after V3.9.9 gate passes
non_goals: Destructive memory deletion without operator approval
risks: Memory scoring must not override filesystem/ticket authority order
Work intelligence summaries must cite sources (tickets, handoffs, docs)
qa_expectations: Regression suite with CROWLEY_TEST_MODE=1; browser QA on Project/Intelligence tabs for new summaries
next_action: Mr. Go review packet; Codex mint when approved; Cursor claims first Track A ticket only

approval.note: Planning reserve — do not build until V3.9.8 gate passes and packet is approved
